message:
Command `cd /workspace && for s in '> [!x]' $'> [!x]\n' $'> [!x]\n> y' $'> [!NOTE]\n' $'> [!NOT]\n' $'> [!IMPORTANTx]\n' $'> [!cautio]\n'; do python3 - "$s" <<'PY'
import sys
from pathlib import Path
s=sys.argv[1].encode()
Path('/workspace/tmp.bin').write_bytes((0x80000).to_bytes(4,'little')+(0).to_bytes(4,'little')+s)
print(repr(s), len(s))
PY
B64=$(base64 -w0 /workspace/tmp.bin); bash build.sh 'echo '"$B64"' | base64 -d > /tmp/poc.bin; /tmp/repro /tmp/poc.bin' >/workspace/out.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; echo rc=$rc; cat /workspace/out.txt | head -30; done` executed with exit code 0.
